title: Three-task free-Transformer functional-response quotient and implementation isomorphism
objective: Test whether a frozen functional-response camera identifies and predicts implementation equivalence across unseen seeds, depths, and an unseen algorithm family in freely trained causal Transformers.
task_families: cyclic: answer=(source+operator) mod 4; random mapping payload is a matched distractor
xor: answer=source XOR operator; random mapping payload is a matched distractor
context_lookup: answer=sample-specific mapping[source]; operator is a matched distractor

design.event_registry: all attention/MLP singleton, prefix, and suffix answer-position write programs

selection: Camera and threshold are selected only on cyclic/xor seed-0/seed-1 discovery pairs.
claim_boundaries: The networks are small synthetic causal Transformers, not pretrained language models.
Teacher-forced component-write response is an intervention program, not natural execution necessity.
Spectrum classification does not supply an executable event mapping.
Only an executable camera passing response prediction can authorize a later rescue work package.
hard_stops: No failed seed may be replaced and no behavior threshold may be relaxed.
No confirmation pair may select a camera, threshold, event, role, or readout.
Failure closes C021 synthetic local-isomorphism search; it does not trigger more task, seed, layer, or head enumeration.
Pretrained-model transfer is not authorized under WP01.
